text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Global first records of non-native species
The number of established alien species and the year they were first recorded outside of their native range. A
species may be counted multiple times, once for each new country they are found in.

tspan.tspan: Records after 2000 are not automatically shown as there is a reporting lag, which means values for these years are underestimated.
